chunks: Surely when We pound the earth to powder grounded, pounded to dust,
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the earth is pounded to dust in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Fajr (84:3) is often interpreted as the literal physical upheaval of the earth, symbolizing the dissolution of worldly structures before the gathering of humanity. It serves as a powerful reminder of God's absolute sovereignty over creation, reinforcing the concept of *Qiyamah* (Resurrection) where the physical realm is transformed to facilitate the final judgment.
